description.value: Bonpot (本锅) is a Chinese restaurant in Richmond's Alexandra Road food corridor, specialising in hot pot dining. It sits in a unit within a commercial plaza, placing it among the dense concentration of Asian restaurants that make this stretch a notable food destination for cyclists riding through Richmond.
